response.sql: WITH race_standings AS (SELECT r.name, ds.driverId, ds.points FROM driverStandings ds INNER JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId), race_stats AS (SELECT name, AVG(points) as avg_points, COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) as driver_count FROM race_standings GROUP BY name), overall_avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(driver_count) as avg_count FROM race_stats), filtered_races AS (SELECT rs.avg_points, rs.driver_count, oa.avg_count FROM race_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_avg_count oa WHERE rs.driver_count > oa.avg_count) SELECT AVG(avg_points) as avg_of_avg_points, AVG(driver_count) as avg_of_counts, AVG(driver_count - avg_count) as avg_excess FROM filtered_races
